name: Challenge skillfully
definition: Challenge respectfully when things don't make sense and back yourself. Value independent thinking. Discuss openly, listen, then drive the decision quickly.

rows.situation: When something does not make sense
rows.under: Goes along. Does not say the thing that is wrong.
rows.justRight: Challenges respectfully when the plan does not make sense. Backs the challenge with a reason, not a vibe.
rows.over: Challenges everything as a habit. Respect becomes a preface for a fight.

rows.under: Drops a good point the first time someone pushes back.
rows.justRight: Backs themselves when they have done the thinking. Holds the point long enough for others to hear it.
rows.over: Digs in after the evidence has moved. Confuses backing yourself with never being wrong.

rows.under: Echoes the room. Brings no view of their own.
rows.justRight: Values independent thinking. Forms a view before the meeting, then tests it in the open.
rows.over: Treats independence as a refusal to listen. The view never updates.

rows.under: Holds the real objection until after the meeting, or talks over the people who disagree.
rows.justRight: Discusses openly, then listens. Changes their mind when the better argument shows up.
rows.over: Turns every discussion into a debate to win. Listening is a pause before the next rebuttal.

rows.under: Leaves the room without a decision. The debate continues in chat.
rows.justRight: After the open discussion, drives the decision quickly. People know what was decided and why.
rows.over: Cuts the discussion short to look decisive. The decision does not survive the first question.
